git-read.js.reason: Read-only Git async helper. Filesystem use is limited to HEAD, private index and paused-operation metadata discovery/stat; no file writes. Git children disable optional locks and index refresh.

integration-read-worker.js.reason: Display-only worker; mutation methods are guarded and arbitrary children denied. Existing record-save readiness may create/copy/delete only its owned os.tmpdir()/hub-record-index-* directory and run intent-to-add/commit --only --dry-run against its private GIT_INDEX_FILE with hooks/signing disabled. Real index/ref/worktree writes, save/apply/dispatch/restart are not exposed. Git reads run through parent async RPC.

idea-spool-index.js.reason: Read-only worker index of request identities and compact maintenance archive receipts; absence is fenced for missing/corrupt catalog. Legacy v1 batches without a receipt use their fixed plan, complete run inventory and content-bound request identities; only changed stamps cause worker rereads. No filesystem mutation or ledger write.

handoff-scan.js.reason: Read-only finished-receipt scanner for display and periodic preflight only. Filesystem references here install deny guards for writes/open-for-write and process launches; the fixed scan message calls existing pending/failure readers only. No completion, adoption, recovery or action is exposed. Action paths retain current synchronous validation.

handoff-admission.js.reason: Strict action preflight Worker: filesystem references install fail-closed write/open restrictions only; fixed scan operation reads temporary/active spool metadata and receipts, cannot write ledger, spool or launch children. Action/permission remains owned by parent after await.
